title: Enable PWA installation and offline startup
description: Add a web app manifest and service worker that make the static application installation-ready and cache the application shell for offline startup after one successful load.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid manifest declares application name, icons, start URL, display mode, and theme metadata
The production build registers a service worker under the intended scope
The static shell and required same-origin startup assets are cached after initial load
Starting the installed or production application offline renders the shell and persisted projects
Offline startup does not require a backend or network fallback

steps.details: Create the manifest and required local icon assets, then link the manifest from the application document with stable start URL and standalone display metadata.
Select and configure a Vite-compatible PWA approach that emits a scoped service worker and precache manifest for production assets; document its license.
Register the worker from the host layer, report registration failure as a non-destructive offline-capability warning, and keep application rendering independent of registration success.
Build and serve production output, then assert manifest fields, service-worker control, and local icon availability through browser-visible or standards-level checks.
Load once online, create a project, switch the browser context offline, reload or reopen, and assert the shell and persisted project render without failed network dependence.

technicalNotes: Service workers require a secure context except on localhost.
Cache immutable build assets; do not treat IndexedDB user records as cache entries.
